text:
Maria Chen: @channel seeing a sudden spike in 5xx and tail latency on prod inference (eu-west-1). Long prompts returning 503s. Opening a quick war-room. Bridge: https://meet.redwood/warroom/abc123 :rotating_light:

Devon Patel: joining now — pulling logs and metrics

Jonathan Reed: on my way. any idea if it's tenant-specific or global?

oncall-bot: Alert: inference-service-prod-eu-west-1 95p latency > 500ms for 2m

Sai Narayan: quick scan — model-node-12 shows a KV cache miss storm and mem pressure spikes around the same time

Dana Liu: adding calendar invite + bridge: https://meet.redwood/warroom/abc123 — pinging infra.

Maria Chen: Agenda (quick): 1) confirm blast radius, 2) check KV cache eviction / OOMs, 3) mitigation (fallback / scale / revert), 4) postmortem owner?

Devon Patel: logs snippet:
```
[2026-03-17T21:12:45Z] model-node-12 kernel: OutOfMemory: process p455 evicted kvcache
[2026-03-17T21:12:47Z] serve: 503 generate request id=abc-123 lat=1250ms
```

Jonathan Reed: was there a deploy recently?

deploy-bot: Deploy finished: quant-model-v3 -> prod-eu-west-1 at 2026-03-17T20:58:02Z

Maria Chen: OK — quant-model-v3 went out ~20:58. If it's memory-regressive we should fallback to quant-model-v2 while we triage

Sai Narayan: memory/kv eviction graphs look correlated with increased tokenization cost for some long prompts — could be quantization interaction with kvcache layout

Devon Patel: running fallback command now:
```
$ redwood route set-fallback --region eu-west-1 --from quant-model-v3 --to quant-model-v2 --duration 120m
```

Devon Patel: CLI response: ok: routing updated for 42 nodes; fallback in effect

Maria Chen: Nice. Can infra throttle new long-running requests or scale nodes temporarily?

Dana Liu: autoscaler is at max for reserved pool, adding burst machines now and pinging infra-oncall.

Jonathan Reed: tail latency improving on metrics — 95p down from ~1.2s to ~320ms after fallback, but still above SLO. Continuing to monitor.

Sai Narayan: I'm collecting KV eviction counts and memstats, will paste shortly.

Devon Patel: posting quick kibana links: https://kibana.redwood/prod-eu-west1/kvcache?from=21:00&to=21:20

Maria Chen: Summary so far: fallback applied -> partial improvement. Action items: Devon = own incident, gather DB/kvcache stats; Jonathan = confirm no tenant-specific regressions; Dana = follow autoscaler/burst progress; Sai = root-cause hints (quantization vs kvcache). Postmortem owner? Devon on me to draft EOD.

oncall-bot: Incident created: INC-2026-03217 assigned to Devon Patel

Jonathan Reed: thumbs up. I'll validate canary traffic for quant-model-v2 and run a few long prompt checks

Devon Patel: watching logs — no further OOMs in last 2m. Will keep the fallback until we know safe to roll forward.

Maria Chen: If anyone sees new 5xxs after 21:30 escalate to full incident call. For now stay on bridge for 10m. Thanks all :thumbsup:

Dana Liu: infra has added 6 burst machines; autoscaler reports healthy.

Sai Narayan: KV eviction rate pasted to thread and shared dashboard. Initial hypothesis: quant-model-v3 increases per-token working set, bumping kvcache pressure under long prompt mix.

Devon Patel: I'll capture heap profiles and compare v2 vs v3, will update here.

Maria Chen: Great. We'll reconvene in 15m if needed. Closing ad-hoc war-room for now but keep channel open.

Jonathan Reed: +1

oncall-bot: Incident INC-2026-03217 status: triage in-progress

Devon Patel: assigning followups in ticket and will draft timeline.

Maria Chen: thanks team — good triage. :white_check_mark:
